task_description: Write a method in Dafny that takes in a string and character, replaces blank spaces in the string with the character, and returns the string.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ReplaceSpaces(s: string, c: char) returns (v: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The length of the returning string must be the same as the length of the input string
- All blank spaces in the input string are replaced with the character c in the output string
- All other characters are unchanged
